# constparity_expect.txt -- the constant-parity matrix's expectations, the input
# of tests/unit/constparitygen.z (`make regen-constparity`). Every kind of
# unit-level constant crossed with every reader is read in three positions: U
# (a unit constant computed from it), D (the same expression in a body) and L
# (the expression on a body local holding it). A row is
#
#   selector  reader[/U|/D|/L]  verdict  detail
#
# selector   a kind, `*`, or a group `@<tag>` (num lit str static sum opt fn)
# verdict    RUN with the value printed; REFUSED with `Ennnn message` (@N -- the
#            type as the compiler names it); NA with the reason the cell
#            cannot be written; KNOWN with the defect that keeps the cell from
#            agreeing (emitted nowhere in the fixtures)
#
# The LAST row selecting a cell decides it; every cell needs a row. The
# positions of a reader must agree -- the same value, or the same error code --
# except U's E0600 "no compile-time value" beside a body that runs the read.
# The generator refuses a table that breaks this: a disagreement is KNOWN.

# -- intlit
intlit    mem          RUN      7
intlit    unknown      REFUSED  E0100 type 'i64' has no member 'zork'
intlit    interp/U     REFUSED  E0600 an interpolated string has no compile-time value
intlit    interp/D     RUN      7
intlit    interp/L     RUN      7
intlit    eq           RUN      true
intlit    read         RUN      7

# -- fnref
fnref     unknown/U    NA       a bare function name is a reference at unit level and a call in a body
